purpose: A connected raised rice granary and unloading court that extends the west-bank wine supply chain northward.
hero: raised six-column granary seen through the east gate

circulation.primary: west water street -> 1.90 m east gate -> unloading court -> 1.54 m store door
circulation.production: wine back lane -> unloading sacks and scale -> raised dry store

structure: overlapped land support and continuous west water street
thick split east wall with real gate and solidified roof
six granary posts on six stone shoes with complete beam ring
raised timber floor above splash level and three-step store access
split plank facade with real east-facing door
solidified gabled roof, continuous ridge and screened ventilation openings
